predict: GenKI is a novel framework or system designed to enhance open-domain question answering (OpenQA) by integrating knowledge and enabling controllable generation within large language models. It is proposed to improve the performance of OpenQA tasks by leveraging knowledge integration and controllable generation. GenKI has been evaluated on various datasets such as TriviaQA, MSMARCO, and CMRC, and has demonstrated superior performance compared to baseline models. The code for GenKI is available on GitHub at https://github.com/USTCStarTeam/GenKI.
